name: load_script_0043e710_wave11
description: AnimationObject_LoadScript compiled with native LTCG so the resource arrives in ECX, the object in EAX and the index in EBX (retail's triple). The pass derives that from the body: the resource is declared first, the first flag mask is a named local stored later, and the final flag clear is a read-modify-write through a plain uint32_t* (a volatile pointer keeps retail's load/and/store but forces the coalesced ESI entry).

functions.name: AnimationObject_LoadScript
functions.actual_abi: resource in ECX (copied to ESI at entry), object in EAX (copied to EDI), index in EBX, zero in EBP; plain RET

context.description: Synthetic array-walking caller that keeps the function reachable and non-inlinable; not recovered game code.
